concerns.text: T017 claims dependency on T004.1 ('This task depends on T004.1 schema'), but T004.1 (Create dataset.schema.yaml) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) in Phase 2. A consumer task (T017) cannot logically precede its producer (T004.1) in the execution order. The schema must be generated before the preprocessing logic that validates against it can be implemented or tested.

T026 consumes 'data/processed/mapped_data.parquet' generated by T019.2. However, T019.2 is in Phase 2 (Foundational) and marked `[ ]` (incomplete), while T026 is in Phase 4 (US2) and marked `[X]` (complete). This violates the producer-before-consumer rule; the mapping artifact does not exist for T026 to consume.

T030 (LODO CV) depends on T009.3 (Synthetic Multi-Dataset Generator) to provide 'distinct biological stress vectors'. T009.3 is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) in Phase 2, yet T030 is marked `[X]` (complete) in Phase 5. The validation logic cannot execute without the multi-dataset artifacts produced by T009.3.

T042 (Execute quickstart.md) requires the existence of `data/results/model_metrics.json`. This artifact is produced by T046 (Implement code/main.py), which is listed in 'Revision Tasks' and marked `[ ]` (incomplete). T042 is marked `[X]` (complete). This creates a circular dependency where the verification task (T042) is marked complete before the orchestration task (T046) that generates the required output exists.

T007.1 (Implement checksum verification) depends on the existence of the state file `state/projects/PROJ-455...yaml` to record `artifact_hashes`. The task description implies this file must exist or be created. However, T001 (Create project structure) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). If the directory structure for `state/` is not created by T001, T007.1 cannot execute. T001 must be completed before T007.1.
